According to JP wiki data, this is acquired during "Historical events "special race", "Treasure Hunt"". If it follows the rules of past Historical Event treasure boxes, it will randomly drop one of the following:

Traveler of the Ages Robe
Traveler of the Ages Dress
Pilgrim of the Ages Boots
Fortune Blade
Document Storage Expansion
Equipment Storage Expansion
Celebratory Wooden Paneling
Festival Wooden Paneling
Spikenard Oil
Fragment of Secret No-war Pact x3
Adventure Skills Adv. Manual x5

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Item/Consumer/strongbox (fourth entry from the bottom of the list)

GAMA plays by different rules, though, so some of the contents *Cough* ship panels and expansion tools *Cough* could be altered/absent from the above list. I suspect the "special race" is linked to the current Azores race, but have yet to determine that for certain. Perhaps after a few more repeats of the race...

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
An excellent guide on the Azores race has been posted to the OGP forums by [CA]EvilLynn. You can find it under the Guides and Tips section, or use this address shortcut:

nforum.ogplanet.com/uwo/forum_posts.asp?TID=617256

Just remember to add the usual Hypertext Transfer Protocol bit before it. And, Chronic: I don't approve of these substitutions either, but I understand the reasoning behind it. KOEI runs the game as a business, and unless it generates money, it's not worth a thing to them -- Asian servers, I've been told, charge a monthly subscription fee, so of course the rewards will be better there. (We get 3 SWMPs for 20ish races, JP players got a Wind King Amulet.) It helps motivate you to keep playing, as well as keep paying.

As GAMA is free (and I know I wouldn't be here if it weren't), valuable items like those mentioned above will, of course, be changed for something of lesser value; otherwise people wouldn't invest in Astros, which does help to keep the game afloat. As for me, I'm happy just to have the title, and to have helped some other people run the event at the same time.

Cheers, and safe sailing / favorable box drops to you all.
